description: Step 4 of the extern door collapse (approved 2026-09-13: the manifest goes entirely, nothing replaces it). After fz-21x.3 (addresses by dynamic export) and fz-21x.4 (comparison binding deleted), RUNTIME_SYMBOLS restates the extern declaration's abi and lanes for the sole purpose of refusing a declaration that disagrees with the runtime. The declaration defines how the export is called; every lib extern is exercised by fixtures on three doors, so a wrong lane shows up there; a user declaration of a runtime symbol is trusted like any C prototype (fixtures such as 00556 declare fz_op_* themselves on purpose). Deleted: RUNTIME_SYMBOLS, RuntimeSymbol, RuntimePhysicalContract, runtime_symbol_abi, runtime_physical_contract, validate_runtime_symbol_shape, declare_manifest_scalar_import (fz_value_cmp_ref becomes an ordinary import-table row), the ABI-mismatch check in resolve_extern_abi and in the interpreter's resolve_symbol, and the tests runtime_physical_contracts_validate_every_kernel_gateway, abi_refusal_test, compiler2_refuses_a_runtime_symbol_declared_with_the_wrong_abi. Kept: extern ABI name must parse; extern "fz" reserved to bootstrap; no variadic "fz". fz-5xp.32 closes as superseded. No namespace rule, no conformance test.
title: Delete the runtime symbol manifest
